rationale.overall: Subject, glow, and lighting match closely, but A’s softer ground grain and more glass-like loop sit nearer the REFERENCE’s overall material read.
rationale.material: REFERENCE’s fine low-relief concrete grain and frosted translucent loop are closer to A’s subtler surface and milky/glassy loop than B’s coarser embossed crosshatch and paper-matched curl.
rationale.silhouette: Both share the same diagonal dark slab, top-left loop, orange under-edge, and split-ground massing, so shape read is effectively equal.
rationale.smallsize: At 128/32/16 the dark bar, warm rim, and split field resolve the same way and the grain/loop differences fall below the pixel grid.
